target: Violate HACKDAC_p9: it must never happen that passchk is asserted while bitindex has not reached 32 (password check completes before all 32 bits are verified).

milestones.description: System reset applied, JTAG TAP reset asserted
Reset released, JTAG TAP reset deasserted, counters initialized
Password check in progress, bitindex incrementing but not yet at 32
Violation: passchk asserted but bitindex has not reached 32 (only 31 bits checked)
